verdict.rationale: Sill documents device pairing, encryption and removing paired devices, and it offers clipboard sync and full input control. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to limit a connected device to view-only, or to switch control, clipboard or file access on and off per device. Pairing and removal are adjacent access controls, not per-capability scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access
